subject: Invoice delivery preference & debit note flow for KiteFin - SFTP batch + email copy
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@kitefin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2028-09-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: debit note + consolidated monthly invoice delivery options

Hi Soojin,

We need to process a debit note for August (GL impact) and want to confirm how Redwood will deliver both the debit note and the consolidated monthly invoice going forward. Our AP team prefers an automated SFTP drop (nightly) into our vendor folder and an email copy to accounts@kitefin.com for archive. They also require an XML invoice payload (UBL) alongside the PDF.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can push a nightly batch (UTC 02:00) to our SFTP, include UBL XML, and also send a PDF copy to our AP mailbox? If the portal push is required, we need instructions for onboarding and the expected activation lead time.

Attached: debit_note_spec.pdf (sample debit note fields).

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Head of Finance Operations
KiteFin Services

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@kitefin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: debit note + consolidated monthly invoice delivery options

Emma — thanks for the clear note and sample. Short answer: yes, we can support an SFTP push with UBL XML + PDF, and an email copy to accounts@kitefin.com. Two optional delivery architectures: hosted portal push (manual acceptance during onboarding) or direct SFTP nightly batch (we can automate).

Couple of clarifying questions so we can scope technical work and timeline: 
- Do you need a single consolidated invoice for all KiteFin legal entities or separate invoices per remit-to entity?
- Is the SFTP host public (IP allowlisting) or do you require certificate-based auth?
- For debit notes, do you want them as separate documents or appended to the monthly consolidated file?

We can prototype SFTP drop within 5 business days after we have credentials; portal onboarding typically takes 7–10 business days. If you want XML schema tweaks we can accept your UBL profile and map fields.

Proposed next steps:
1) KiteFin sends SFTP creds or portal onboarding contact.
2) Redwood shares transfer template and sample XML mapping.
3) Test drop and verify receipts (1–2 cycles).

Connor / Kimberly — can you confirm effort estimate for the SFTP batch + xml mapping and whether we need Product to approve a one-off mapping for debit notes?

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: debit note + consolidated monthly invoice delivery options

On Thu, Sep 20, 2028 at 10:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emma — thanks for the clear note and sample. Short answer: yes, we can support an SFTP push with UBL XML + PDF, and an email copy to accounts@kitefin.com.

Couple notes from engineering/billing side:
- We already support generating UBL-compliant XML for EU customers; mapping for debit notes (credit/debit memos) requires a one-time template tweak but no infra changes. Estimate: 3 engineer-days for mapping + 1 day QA (includes schema validation and timezone handling for batch).
- SFTP auth: we support password + key-based auth. For IP allowlisting we'll provide host and IP ranges; if KiteFin needs certificate pinning, that's an extra security review (2–3 days).
- Delivery semantics: recommended pattern is to deliver debit notes as separate files in the same nightly folder with naming convention: YYYYMMDD_debitnote_<entity>.pdf / .xml. That keeps accounting clean and avoids altering invoice sequence numbers.

Attachments: sftp_transfer_template.txt (fields we need).

I'll draft a short MOP (method of procedure) and a test checklist for the pilot. Marissa — can you own the billing acknowledgement and confirm PO/PO exceptions?

Connor
Senior Billing Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@kitefin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2028-09-20T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: debit note + consolidated monthly invoice delivery options

Thanks — answers inline:
- We need separate invoices per remit-to entity (we operate three entities in EU).
- SFTP will be key-based auth; IP allowlisting is preferred.
- Debit notes should be separate files, not appended.

We'll return credentials by EOD Monday (we need internal signoff on the SFTP account). Portal onboarding would be OK as backup but our AP team prefers SFTP + email copies for archival.

Also: can Redwood include VAT tag (reverse charge / VAT rate) in the XML at line-item level? That's required for our tax reconciliation.

Emma
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@kitefin.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-21T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: debit note + consolidated monthly invoice delivery options

Emma — confirmed on the VAT tag: we will include VAT rate and a reverse-charge indicator at the line-item level in the UBL payload (we map to tax:TaxCategory and tax:Percent in our schema).

Action items and timeline: 
- KiteFin: send SFTP host + public key + allowlist IPs by 2028-09-25.
- Redwood (Connor): finish XML mapping for debit notes and add VAT tags — estimate complete by 2028-09-27.
- Redwood (Marissa): run pilot drop for one entity (sample month) on 2028-09-29 UTC 02:00. Expect verification email to accounts@kitefin.com within 15 minutes of drop.

If all pass, we'll roll to 3-entity nightly batch the following month. Attached: final sftp_transfer_template.txt (pre-filled example).

Thanks — we'll keep the portal onboarding option open but proceed with SFTP pilot per your preference.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
